item.title: Iran conflict exposes America’s Achilles’ heel
item.description: Diesel prices have spiked to $5.96 per gallon in premium markets as escalating Middle East tensions collide with America's crumbling refinery base. The surge comes at a critical inflection point for trucking, with tender rejection rates climbing and capacity tightening after a brutal four-year freight recession, raising questions about whether the industry can capitalize on the recovery when fuel costs threaten to erase margin gains.
